fields.meta_description: Build an insurance verification form that collects card photos before the visit and keeps the benefits your staff confirm on the same record.
fields.h1: Build an Insurance Verification Form With a Staff Worksheet
fields.hero_description: Describe how your office checks coverage. Emergent builds the insurance verification form patients fill in with card photos, plus the worksheet staff complete after each payer call.
fields.features_subheading: A PDF leaves a blank for the member ID. This form collects the policy and keeps what staff confirm beside it.
fields.feature_1:
Card photos, front and back

Patients photograph both sides of their insurance card on a phone before the visit. Staff read the member ID and group number from the image instead of the card at check-in.
fields.feature_2:
Policyholder details for dependents

Ask whether the patient holds the policy. When a child is covered on a parent's plan, the form collects the parent's name and employer on the same record as the child.
fields.feature_3:
A benefits worksheet for staff

Give staff a second form to complete after the payer call or portal check. It records the deductible met and the copay, plus any prior authorization the service needs.
fields.feature_4:
Secondary insurance on one record

Add a second policy section that opens only when a patient says they have one. Both plans sit on one record, marked with the order they pay in, and billing sends claims to match.
fields.feature_5:
Rechecks before return visits

Set a recheck date on each record, such as the start of a new plan year. Each Monday, staff get an email listing the booked patients whose coverage needs another look that week.
fields.feature_6:
Code that moves with your practice

Export the full codebase to GitHub when a developer wants the form inside your patient portal, or wants to connect it to the practice management system you already run.
fields.why_title: Why Build Insurance Verification on Emergent?
fields.why_description: A printed verification sheet ends up in a paper chart. Nobody can sort a drawer of them to see whose benefits run out this month.

fields.usecase_heading: Verification for Four Kinds of Front Desk
fields.tab_content_1:
Patients see a crown estimate of $600 before the visit

Bright Harbor Dental confirms every plan ahead of treatment. For one patient, the coordinator records a $1,500 annual maximum with $1,120 left, on a plan that pays half of every crown. The form splits the $1,200 crown into a $600 plan share and a $600 patient estimate, then emails that estimate to the patient.
fields.tab_content_2:
Billing calls any patient 3 visits from the cap

Each patient at Cedar Ridge Physical Therapy has a running count of covered visits for the year. When a plan allows 20 and a patient has used 17, the form posts to #billing in Slack. The billing lead calls the patient before the next session to plan what happens after visit 20.
fields.tab_content_3:
Every knee scope holds for its authorization number

Lakeview Surgery Center books no knee scope until the payer approves it. The verification record shows coverage confirmed and authorization pending. Once the scheduler enters the authorization number the payer issued, the surgery date opens and the patient gets a confirmation email.
fields.tab_content_4:
No lienholder on the policy means no keys

Before a financed car leaves the lot at Northgate Motors, the buyer uploads an insurance card and declarations page from a phone. The finance manager checks the VIN and the collision and comprehensive coverage. A policy missing the lender goes back with one note: add Fairway Credit Union as lienholder.

fields.howto_title: How to Create Insurance Verification Forms
fields.howto_description: Settle what the payer has to confirm before you describe the form.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Collect the card before the visit
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Plan for patients with two plans
fields.howto_step_1_des: Ask for the insurance card when the appointment is booked, not at check-in. A photo of each side gives staff the member ID and the payer's phone number days ahead, with time to sort out a plan that has changed.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down the answers your billing team needs from each payer: active dates, deductible met, copay, coverage percentage, and prior authorization. Those become the worksheet fields, in the order staff hear them on a call or read them in a portal.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Some practices verify before every visit, others only for new patients and anyone whose plan changed. Pick your rule and name an owner for each group of payers. Records with no owner are the ones that sit unchecked until the claim comes back denied.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Patients covered by two plans need both on file. Add a yes-or-no question that opens a second policy section, and record which plan pays first. Billing sends the claim to that payer before sending the balance to the other one.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the patient questions and the staff worksheet into one plain-English prompt. Emergent builds both forms and the table that joins them. When a payer changes what it asks for, or you want a new field, ask for the change in the same chat.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Connect email and your other tools
fields.howto_step_6_des: Connect email for estimates and recheck reminders, and Slack for alerts to billing. Any system with an API, such as your scheduling or billing software, can receive each verified record the moment a staff member saves it.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run a test patient end to end
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book yourself as a patient using your own card. Upload both sides, then complete the worksheet the way staff would after a payer call. Check the estimate math and confirm the record appears in the table with the right visit date.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is static templates (Formstack, Formplus, pdfFiller, two eForms PDFs, an S10.AI blog post, a Pinterest board) that stop at blank lines for member ID and group number. This page treats insurance verification as two halves: the patient or customer submits card photos and policy details, then staff record what the payer confirmed, and the record decides what happens next: a cost estimate, a visit-count warning, a held surgery date or a held car delivery.

A surgery center holds a knee scope on the schedule until the scheduler enters the prior authorization number the payer issued.
A car dealership's finance desk sends a buyer's policy back because the bank is not listed as lienholder, so the car does not leave the lot.

claims_to_source: Insurance verification means confirming a patient's active coverage and benefits with the payer before the visit, by phone, payer portal or an electronic eligibility check
A health insurance card shows the member ID and group number used to check coverage
Dental plans commonly set an annual maximum and pay major services such as crowns at a lower percentage, often 50%, than preventive care
Some health plans require prior authorization before certain procedures or services
Some health plans limit the number of covered physical therapy visits per year
Lenders financing a car usually require collision and comprehensive coverage and require the lender to be listed as lienholder or loss payee on the policy
